name: Abelian Sandpile
desc: An Abelian sandpile grows from a slowly-wandering pour source into the iconic self-similar mandala of nested squares and diamonds, its four grain-heights mapped to a vivid indigo-magenta-gold-white ramp while toppling avalanches shimmer along the perpetually expanding self-organized-critical frontier.

scale.doc: cell size / grid coarseness (higher = chunkier cells, fewer columns)

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude + avalanche shimmer brightness

density.doc: pour rate (grains dropped per second -> growth speed & avalanche activity)

hue.doc: base palette hue (rotates the whole height ramp)

x.doc: pour source center x (the mandala's origin)

style.doc: render philosophy: spectral indigo->magenta->gold->white / thermal blackbody / copper-oxide patina greens+rust / grayscale-topographic elevation bands (mono abstract) / neon-contour glowing height-region outlines only (abstract)

seed.doc: deterministic variation (seed>0 adds asymmetric secondary pour sources)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg; lower = translucent trails)
